topic: K-Stick and the Chair That Needs a Break
hook_text: K-Stick finds a chair... but the chair is already tired!
background: Simple classroom corner with a plain floor, small desk, and one chair
main_expression: Curious surprise turning into exaggerated confusion
main_pose: K-Stick leans forward with one hand on his chin, then reaches toward the chair
prop: A simple school chair with tiny cartoon eyes and a miniature 'OUT OF ENERGY' sign
scene_1: K-Stick walks into the classroom, sees the empty chair, and happily points at it. He says, 'Perfect!'
scene_2: As K-Stick pulls the chair out, it suddenly unfolds a tiny sign reading 'OUT OF ENERGY' and slowly flops sideways.
scene_3: K-Stick looks shocked, then gently places a tiny paper cup beside the chair like he is giving it a break.
twist_ending: K-Stick finally sits on the floor instead. The chair instantly pops upright, sits on the floor beside him, and displays a new sign: 'Much better!'
